messages:
Janelle: Quick thought — can we add a "sessionized amortized cost" card to the console? Need to show token cost + apportioned cache savings across multi-model chains. Right now the per-route view double-counts prefetch. /cc @Samir
Samir: Yes. We should attribute cache savings by session and by originating route. Prefer amortize by first-invocation token length. Example logic below.
Mike: sketch: ```python
# for each session
base_cost = sum(tokens * model_rate)
prefetch_savings = sum(prefetched_tokens * saved_rate)
amortized = base_cost - (prefetch_savings / session_length)
```
Anna L.: UX Q: that's a lot of numbers. Could we surface a single "net unit cost" sparkline and then let folks drilldown into "cache contribution" and "per-model delta"? :thinking_face:
econ-bot: sample-output: net_unit_cost: $0.0032 | cache_credit: $0.0008 | models: [gpt-open-7b: $0.0022, reranker-1: $0.0001]
Samir: Also need to consider routing fallbacks — if sticky-routing moves to cheaper model mid-session the amortization should follow the invocation path, not the route id.
Mike: Good point. Implementation note: persist invocation-path fingerprint at session start: `inv_path_id = sha(session_id + route + first_model)` then use that to join telemetry when computing amortized savings.
Anna L.: For rollout: show new card behind feature flag + 10% of orgs; A/B metric = avg net_unit_cost & developer complaints (support tickets) :+1:
Janelle: Perfect. @Anna L. can you mock the card before EOD? @Samir can you draft the telemetry SQL joins we'll need?
Samir: On it. I'll post a quick query later today.
Mike: I'll add a lightweight aggregation job to emit per-inv_path_id aggregates. Keep it cheap — sample 5% by default.
Anna L.: will deliver mock by 17:00 PST :rocket:
Janelle: Thanks all. Putting this on the eng-platform board.
